article.title: MMA公布新加坡TMI 2026，11月24至25日聚焦AI行銷實作
article.title_en: MMA announces Singapore’s TMI 2026 for hands-on AI marketing on November 24–25
article.summary: 11月5日公告安排在Gardens by the Bay舉行兩日活動，面向APAC行銷及增長管理層。
article.summary_en: The November 5 announcement schedules a two-day Gardens by the Bay event for APAC marketing and growth leaders.
highlights: 體驗區規劃涵蓋洞察與資料、跨渠道創意、商務與量度。
主辦方安排實作及案例環節；活動尚未舉行。
highlights_en: Planned zones cover insights/data, omnichannel creative, and commerce/measurement.
The organizer plans hands-on work and cases; the event has not yet taken place.
article.why: 規劃團隊培訓時，可按現有AI導入問題篩選議程，讓學習對應具體工作與決策。
article.why_en: Teams planning training can select sessions around actual AI adoption problems and related decisions.
article.next_step: 先看最新議程、票務及所需工具，列出一項希望帶回團隊驗證的流程；毋須因活動公告立即採購。
article.next_step_en: Review the current agenda, ticket terms and tool requirements, and identify one workflow to validate afterward.
article.detail: MMA把活動定位為由概念走向實作的行銷交流，公告提到工作坊、體驗區及組織治理框架。這些屬主辦方的內容規劃，不能當作已發生的學習成果或商業成效。11月5日是公告日期，正式活動預定11月24至25日，兩者不可混淆。參與團隊宜自行核對最新場次、費用、資料分享及工具帳戶要求，本報未替任何人登記或購票。
article.detail_en: Workshops, zones and governance frameworks are organizer plans, not demonstrated learning or business outcomes. November 5 is the announcement date; the event is scheduled for November 24–25. Check current sessions, fees, data-sharing conditions and account needs before attending.
